I'd recommend we go with a peer facilitator from outside both merged groups if we can identify someone suitable, with me participating as a regular council member rather than chair. So I'd strongly support keeping the council free of anyone with direct supervisory authority over participants, consistent with Maya's policy constraint. I'd also suggest we think about how the anonymous written question channel Maya mentioned could work in practice — employees who are hesitant to speak even in a peer-facilitated setting need an alternative path to raise concerns.
